credits: WORDS: Arabella K. Hankey, 1866.  MUSIC: “Hankey”; William G. Fischer, pub.1869.  Public Domain.
I Love to Tell the Story
Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul. Psa. 66:16

editionNotes: Edition, same-hymn/text scope, and permitted public-distribution territory need final selection review; no protected additions or recording-specific arrangements cleared.
Independent review combines semantic audits and full paired visual overviews, with8 focused full-size reviews; it is not human note-by-note proofreading or ABCJS browser certification.

Source part/voice structure is retained; chord members without a voice tag inherit their chord-root voice. The sole PDF-supported regrouping is explicitly documented for the final We Rest on Thee unison. Counts are not an assertion of four independent SATB lines.
changes: Imported the selected ABCJS-compatible edition without changing notation or printed lyrics.
